categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in IPTV integrated broadcasting control services, offering a range of services including live TV channels, video on demand, music, games, and online education. It also engages in satellite TV channel agency, product sales, and copyright distribution. The IPTV business is divided into basic services, value-added services, and shopping channel transmission services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages IPTV technology integrated with cloud computing, big data, and artificial intelligence to provide multi-screen interactive media services. It has developed proprietary platforms such as the intelligent super media cloud platform, IPTV soft terminal service platform, and intelligent operation systems. The company also applies AI-driven content recommendation, intelligent auditing, and integrates AR/VR/MR technologies for innovative applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include telecom operators in Hebei province—Hebei Unicom, Hebei Telecom, and Hebei Mobile—who distribute the IPTV services to end users. The company serves residential IPTV users primarily within Hebei province and is expanding into government and enterprise markets. Its content and services target households, hotels, and institutional clients requiring satellite TV and digital media services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively within Hebei province, China, as the sole authorized IPTV integrated broadcasting control platform operator in the region. Its IPTV services cover the entire province and are delivered through local telecom operators. The company does not operate cross-regionally due to regulatory restrictions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions as a midstream IPTV platform operator, integrating content from national and provincial broadcasters and content providers, encoding and packaging it for transmission via telecom operators' networks to end users. It acts as a content aggregator, broadcaster, and service provider within the IPTV value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing IPTV platform capabilities through system upgrades and cloud platform construction, expanding intelligent operation and AI applications, and developing new media plus technology integration. R&D focuses on AI-driven content recommendation, intelligent auditing, multi-screen interaction, and immersive technologies like VR/AR/MR to innovate IPTV services and expand into smart home and vertical industry applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees from IPTV basic and value-added services, collected via telecom operators. The company earns income from subscription fees for paid content, revenue sharing with operators, and fees from shopping channel transmission services. Additional revenues come from satellite TV channel agency fees, product sales, and copyright licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a unique regional monopoly as the exclusive IPTV integrated broadcasting control platform operator in Hebei province, supported by regulatory and policy barriers. It competes indirectly with other provincial IPTV operators and alternative media platforms but benefits from strong policy support and exclusive authorization, positioning it as a leading IPTV service provider in its region.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 613 million, a slight decline of 5.11% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 261 million, down 7.89%. Total assets grew by 25.55% to RMB 2.61 billion, and net assets increased by 30.42% to RMB 2.46 billion. The company completed its IPO in 2024, enhancing its capital base and supporting future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its exclusive regional IPTV platform authorization, comprehensive content integration, and advanced technology-driven service capabilities. It offers a rich content library with personalized, interactive, and multi-screen viewing experiences, supported by AI and cloud technologies. Its platform serves as a smart home entertainment and service hub, differentiating through innovation, regulatory backing, and strong local market penetration.
